crossRefs.note: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
“Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that…
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that…
When it was day, some of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither…
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

translations.web: Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join themselves to our enemies and fight against us, and escape out of the land.”
translations.bsb: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase even more; and if a war breaks out, they may join our enemies, fight against us, and leave the country.”
translations.kjv: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
translations.asv: come, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they also join themselves unto our enemies, and fight against us, and get them up out of the land.
